Kill [[Selvetarm]] and accompanying foes.

== Quest information ==
=== Objectives ===
* Kill Selvetarm and accompanying foes in [[Slavers' Exile]].
* *BONUS* Kill Selvetarm and accompanying foes in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

=== Reward ===
* 10,000 [[Experience]]
* 1,500 [[Gold]]
* 2,500 [[Deldrimor rank|Dwarf reputation points]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 40 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 100 Zaishen Copper Coins.

== Walkthrough ==
As per the [[The_Last_Hierophant#Selvetarm.27s_level|Selvetarm portion of The Last Hierophant]] quest.
